---
title: "USA Program Map"
---

::: {.hero-banner}
::: {.hero-content}
# NAIA Programs Across the USA
Explore the geographic distribution of all NAIA varsity women's wrestling programs. Click any pin to view campus details and conference affiliation.
:::
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

# Load programs data with coordinates
programs <- read_csv("data/naia_women_programs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude))

# Define distinct athletic colors for each conference
conferences <- sort(unique(programs$conference))
conf_colors <- c(
  "Cascade Collegiate Conference" = "#2563eb",             # Blue
  "Great Plains Athletic Conference" = "#dc2626",          # Red
  "Heart of America Athletic Conference" = "#059669",      # Green
  "Kansas Collegiate Athletic Conference" = "#d97706",     # Amber
  "Mid-South Conference" = "#7c3aed",                      # Purple
  "Sooner Athletic Conference" = "#0891b2"                 # Cyan
)

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = unname(conf_colors[conferences]),
  domain = conferences
)

# HTML popups for clickable pins
popups <- paste0(
  "<div style='font-family: Inter, sans-serif; min-width: 210px; padding: 4px;'>",
  "<h4 style='margin: 0 0 6px 0; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #1e3a8a; font-weight: 700;'>", programs$school, "</h4>",
  "<div style='font-size: 0.85rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px;'>",
  "📍 <strong>Location:</strong> ", programs$city, ", ", programs$state,
  "</div>",
  "<div style='font-size: 0.85rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px;'>",
  "🏆 <strong>Conference:</strong> ", programs$conference,
  "</div>",
  "<div style='margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #0284c7; font-weight: 600;'>",
  "NAIA Varsity Sponsoring Program",
  "</div>",
  "</div>"
)

# Create the Leaflet map
leaflet(programs, width = "100%", height = "650px", options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 12)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -96.5, lat = 39.5, zoom = 4) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    color = "#ffffff",
    fillColor = ~pal(conference),
    radius = 9,
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = popups,
    label = ~paste0(school, " (", city, ", ", state, ")"),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-family" = "Inter, sans-serif", "font-weight" = "500", "padding" = "4px 8px"),
      textsize = "13px",
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~conference,
    title = "Conference",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```
